title: Common Architecture Language Model (CALM) Vocab
description: The nodes and relationships of a CALM architecture, the four kinds of relationship and the decisions between options, and the protocols and metadata they carry.

relationships.description: The links between the architecture's nodes.

controls.description: The controls that apply to the whole architecture.

flows.description: The business flows that run across the architecture.

adrs.description: External links to ADRs (Architecture Decision Records) or similar documents that provide context or decisions related to the architecture. These can be URLs or references to internal documentation.

node.description: A component of the architecture, such as a system, service, database or actor, with its interfaces and controls.

unique-id.description: The node's identifier, unique within the architecture.

node-type.description: What kind of node this is, one of CALM's built-in types or any other name.

description.description: What the node is and does.

details.description: Where a more detailed architecture of this node is, and the pattern it must follow.

detailed-architecture.description: The address of an architecture document that describes this node in detail.

required-pattern.description: The address of a pattern that the detailed architecture must follow.

controls.description: The controls that apply to this node.

relationship.description: A link between nodes, of one of CALM's kinds, or a choice between options.

unique-id.description: The relationship's identifier, unique within the architecture.

relationship-type.description: The kind of the relationship and the nodes it links.

interacts.description: An actor that interacts with nodes.

connects.description: A connection from one node's interfaces to another's.

deployed-in.description: Nodes deployed in a container node.

composed-of.description: Nodes that make up a container node.

options.description: Decisions between options, each naming the nodes and relationships it would add.

controls.description: The controls that apply to this relationship.

interacts-type.description: A relationship in which an actor interacts with nodes.

actor.description: The unique-id of the node that acts.

nodes.description: The unique-ids of the nodes it interacts with.

connects-type.description: A relationship in which one node connects to another through their interfaces.

source.description: The end that opens the connection.

deployed-in-type.description: A relationship in which nodes are deployed in a container node.

container.description: The unique-id of the node the others are deployed in.

nodes.description: The unique-ids of the deployed nodes.

composed-of-type.description: A relationship in which nodes make up a container node.

container.description: The unique-id of the node the others make up.

nodes.description: The unique-ids of the nodes it is made of.

decision.description: One option of a choice, naming the nodes, relationships and controls it would add.

nodes.description: The unique-ids of the nodes this option adds.

relationships.description: The unique-ids of the relationships this option adds.

controls.description: The keys of the controls this option adds.

metadata.description: Free-form metadata, as an object or a list of objects.

node-type-definition.description: CALM's built-in node types. A node may also name a type of its own, so the build publishes this list open to any other string.
